##### Project general facts

Reem Hills Luxury Apartments introduces the Manzel and Majlis clusters, a refined residential offering within the capital's first gated island community. The development presents a versatile collection of homes, including elegantly designed 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments alongside spacious 3-bedroom duplex townhouses. With multiple layouts and design options, every residence is thoughtfully crafted to suit a variety of lifestyles, from young professionals to growing families.

Residents are welcomed into a lifestyle enriched by an impressive suite of amenities designed to nurture wellbeing and connection. Lush landscaped parks, dedicated walking and jogging tracks, multiple swimming pools, and rejuvenating sauna and steam rooms invite relaxation and an active outdoor life, while fully equipped fitness centers and sport courts for tennis and basketball cater to every fitness pursuit. The community further shines with inviting kids' play areas, meet-and-greet lounges, dedicated BBQ spots, a vibrant retail promenade, indoor plazas, a fine dining destination, and even a school, all wrapped in generous covered parking for residents and visitors alike.

Inside, every home embraces comfort and sophistication through thoughtfully composed living and dining spaces, available with closed, open, or combined kitchen layouts to match personal taste. Elegant finishes, premium fittings, and tasteful material choices bring a warm, upscale ambiance to every room, complemented by generous walk-in closets and dedicated storage and laundry areas for effortless living. Expansive balconies and inviting family seating areas extend the living experience outdoors, allowing residents to unwind while enjoying the beauty of their surroundings.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Reem Island is a natural island located in the Arabian Gulf off the coast of Abu Dhabi. The island is connected to the mainland by several bridges, making it easily accessible.

The island has undergone significant development over the past decade and is now a thriving residential and commercial community. It is home to several high-rise residential buildings, as well as office towers, hotels, and shopping centers.

Al Reem Island is known for its luxurious and modern architecture, and many of its buildings offer stunning views of the surrounding sea and cityscape. The island also has several parks and recreational areas, as well as a marina and a promenade along the waterfront.
